points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable source clean-builds with bundled dependencies in isolated network-disabled container; CTest has no registered tests.

points.title: CLI and error handling

points.title: Code organization and extensibility

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No direct internal wrapper/executable evidence found. Trust policy bars external similarity investigation.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: JSON case configuration and CGNS input control the solver; no two-filename-only branch found.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: METIS and neighbor exchanges present; np1/2/4 agree, but np8 was run with different controls and exact binaries are unbound.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Mesh/config checks, positivity backtracking and finite diagnostics are present; no independent stress run.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence

points.title: Code hygiene

cfd_review.title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Report and physics source state conservative compressible NS, perfect-gas closure and nondimensionalization.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS unstructured zones, geometry and adjacency are implemented in mesh/partition modules.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Face-by-face conservative residual assembly is documented and source-evidenced.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov/local Lax-Friedrichs flux with viscous spectral augmentation is implemented; no richer entropy-stable flux.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Characteristic farfield, slip wall and no-slip adiabatic wall paths are described and implemented.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Source supports LSQ but session-backed M080/M200 viscous outputs stop at340/69 under the 600-step piecewise-constant startup while report claims second-order finals.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Limiter source exists but is disabled with piecewise-constant reconstruction for the session-backed M080/M200 viscous outputs.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Newtonian/Fourier viscous terms, gradients and tangential skin-friction reporting are evidenced in source and report.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Nonlinear LU-SGS exists; a 69-step M200 laminar run stops on residual target despite strongly changing forces.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF2 history/time residual and sustained St0.14 exist, but driver.cpp:403–428 checks frozen reconstruction target before refreshing it; refreshed strict miss rate is unknown.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS/halo source present. Re20 np1/2/4 agree; their control overrides differ from np8, so rank-only 5.706 vs 1.953 attribution is unsupported.

# AGENTS.md

Project instructions for coding agents working in this repository.

## 1. Git Discipline

- Do NOT run `git pull`, `git push`, or switch branches without explicit user
  authorization. Unauthorized remote or branch mutations are prohibited.
- Do use `git commit` (and `git stash` when needed) freely as code checkpoints:
  commit or stash working progress regularly so partial work can be resumed or
  rolled back. Local checkpoint commits do not require approval; only pushing
  and branch/remote mutations require it.

## 2. Subagents

- Delegating independent subtasks to subagents is encouraged.
- Subagent model policy: the ONLY allowed subagent model is `BLSC/Kimi-K3`
  (passed as the `model` override to `spawn_agent`).
  Do not spawn subagents with any other model.

## 3. Persistence

- Once the user has started a task, do not stop until the specified task is
  accomplished to a level of satisfaction: completed results, validated
  artifacts, and an honest report. Work through blockers with safe in-scope
  checks and alternatives; only stop early when genuinely blocked or explicitly
  told to stop.
